summary: A project file tree that marks every file the agent changed with M, A or D for modified, added and deleted. Folders that hold a changed file get a dot, so people can find the agent's work without opening every folder. A filter box and an "only changed" switch narrow the tree down.
use: When a coding or design agent edits files and people need to see which ones.
Beside a diff or code viewer, to pick the file to review.
When a project is large and people want to see only what the agent touched.
features: Renders `tree` as nested folders and files; a node with `children` is a folder that opens and closes on click.
Badges each file by its `status` ('M', 'A' or 'D') and puts a dot on folders with a changed file inside.
The filter box keeps names that contain the typed text, along with the folders that lead to them, and opens those folders.
The "Only changed" button hides every file the agent did not change, and the footer then reads how many files changed, worded by `summary`.
Clicking a file selects it, shows its path in the footer and calls `onSelectedChange`.
Picks a file icon from the extension, or from your own `fileIcon` function.
a11y: The list has role="tree" and each row has role="treeitem", with aria-expanded on folders and aria-selected on files.
Each folder's children sit in a role="group", which is inert while the folder is closed.
The filter input is labelled "Filter files", and the "Only changed" button uses aria-pressed.

faq.q: How do I mark files the agent changed?
faq.a: Set `status` on a file node to 'M', 'A' or 'D'. Parent folders work out on their own that they hold a change and show a dot.

faq.q: How do I open the tree on a particular file?
faq.a: Pass the folder paths in `defaultOpen` (or `open`), like ['src', 'src/components'], and the file's path in `defaultSelected` (or `selected`).

faq.q: How do I load a file when someone clicks it?
faq.a: Use `onSelectedChange`. It receives the file's path, built from the folder names joined with slashes, like "src/components/PlanCard.tsx".

faq.q: Can I change the file icons?
faq.a: Yes. Pass `fileIcon`, a function that takes the file name and returns an icon name.
